display_information.name: Kudos Bot
display_information.description: Type /compliment and Kudos Bot posts a random compliment for the whole channel.
display_information.long_description: Kudos Bot is a tiny morale booster for your team. Anyone in a channel can type /compliment and the app instantly posts a random, work-friendly compliment that everyone in the channel can see. Mention teammates, like /compliment @sam @lee, to give each person their own kudos, add a theme (code, teamwork, leadership, design), or type /compliment help for tips. It holds a single permission (commands), stores no tokens, and never reads messages.

slash_commands.description: Post a random compliment to the channel
